source_text:
9.5
πσευδο–διοπηανις ιν «γεοπονιξις» Φασὶ γὰρ οἱ περὶ ∆ημόκριτον καὶ Ἀφρικανὸν ἓξ
μόνας ἡμέρας, καὶ οὐ πλείους, καλῶς διαμένειν πεπανθεῖσαν τὴν σταφυλήν· ἐὰν οὖν
τὸ γίγαρτον μηκέτι χλωρὸν διαφανῇ, ἀλλὰ μέλαν, σημαίνει αὐτὴν ὥριμον εἶναι.
pass_a_gloss: 9.5 Pseudo-Diophanes in Geoponicis. They-say for those about Democritus and Africanus six only days, and not more, well to-remain the having-been-ripened grape; if then the pip no-longer green should-appear, but black, it-signifies it ripe to-be.
pass_b_english: Pseudo-Diophanes, in the Geoponics. For those around Democritus and Africanus say that the ripened grape remains well six days only, and not more; if then the pip no longer appears green, but black, it signifies that it is ripe.

choices.term: ἓξ μόνας ἡμέρας, καὶ οὐ πλείους
choices.english: six days only, and not more
choices.why: ἓξ is 6. The lock's limit is six days, not sixty or an indefinite 'few'.

anf_compare.notes: No PD English of the Cesti body; ANF has the letters only.
